title: Needle in haystack game
author: codergautam
selftext:
After seeing some of the viral games on Twitter I decided to try to make a game similar to the needle in haystack game ([https://needleinhaystack.io](https://needleinhaystack.io)), but with tools and powerups!

Planning to add multiplayer soon

comments.author: GuyjinBu
comments.body: Ok this is hillarious! Well done!

replies.author: codergautam
replies.body: Ah good point, I wanted to make it stand out but will probably reduce size

replies.author: ehhhhokbud
replies.body:
I honestly could see this going viral for how silly it is. Just seems like a good, mindless game. I agree with the other commenter, needle way too big. Frustration is an okay and sometimes fun part of a core gameplay loop. 

Cool idea.
